_note: Assembled from product/recent-deals/inputs/ (tape, parties, supply, demand, calls, HVS, Treasury, RHP price). Every input dated on or before 2026-08-10.

replacement_cost.source_label: HVS U.S. Hotel Development Cost Survey 2026, Exhibit 6 (published July 13, 2026)
replacement_cost.replacement_basis: HVS 2026 median incl. land, blended by keys: Ritz-Carlton 582 keys at the luxury median $1,604,356; JW Marriott 1,010 keys at the full-service median $467,244

spread.source_label: RHP preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5), filed Aug 10, 2026, p. S-3
spread.note: Disclosed cap rate 6.6% = NOI $91.172M (Adjusted EBITDAre $110.005M less FF&E reserve $18.833M, TTM to 6/30/26, seller data, unaudited) / ~$1.38B. FY2025 basis (6.4%) recorded, not graded.

supply.missing: No free source published Orlando's total pipeline (under construction plus planned) as a share of existing rooms as of Aug 10, 2026. Partial-stage figures are shown as context only.

demand.source_label: Orange County Comptroller TDT releases; June 2026 collections released Aug 4, 2026

debt_context.source_label: Agreement of Purchase and Sale (8-K Ex. 10.1), Aug 10, 2026, §2.3(c)
debt_context.note: Arm's-length, no public distress as of Aug 10 (latest public rating action on the $800M ORL 2024-GLKS loan: confirmed, Stable, Dec 10, 2025). The PSA gave the buyer an option to assume the $800M floating-rate CMBS loan, with a loan modification (Schedule 2.3(c)) whose terms aren't public; RHP said funding 'may include' that assumption. On Aug 10 the cash price could therefore have been paid partly in assumed debt on non-public terms, which blurs the price signal. Lowest applicable category: 4. The Sep 1 close 8-K (which lists no assumed loan) is after the announcement and isn't used.
debt_context.summary: Arm's-length; no public distress (latest rating action on the $800M CMBS loan: confirmed, Stable, Dec 2025). Buyer held an option to assume that loan, with modification terms not public, so the price could be paid partly in assumed debt.
